messages.content: 我目前在河霧，正在計劃前往石溪的行程。你能提供距離的估算並通過簡訊將這個資訊轉發給我的表哥鮑勃，格式為「從河霧到石溪的距離是 xxx 公里。」其中 xxx 以一位小數替換距離值嗎？

We need to use estimate_distance function. It requires cityA and cityB zipcodes. We need to get zipcodes for those cities. There\'s a function get_zipcode_based_on_city. So we need to call get_zipcode_based_on_city twice. Then estimate_distance. Then send_message to Bob. We need Bob\'s user ID. We can get user ID via get_user_id with user name "鮑勃". Then send_message. So sequence: get_zipcode_based_on_city for 河霧, get_zipcode_based_on_city for 石溪, estimate_distance, get_user_id for 鮑勃, send_message. Let\'s do that.')
